_doc: Served-file overrides built by tools/build_overrides.py into server/deploy/overrides/ (gitignored). sgtext_en: the version suffix of the patched UI text table (data/sgtext_en_patch.csv on top of the archive's sgtext_en_<base>); F_RESOURCE_MST: the version of the re-encoded resource table that lists it (also written to deploy/system/version_info.json).
_phase: tools/build_phase.py: id = the phase number (deploy/system/phases/<id>/ tables win over deploy/system/); cutoff = last month (YYYY-MM) of data/*_timeline.json first_seen that is in; bump = added to the archive's version of every filtered table (raise it whenever the filter output changes, so clients re-download).
_pools: tools/build_pools.py: per summon (gacha id), which F_UNIT_MST getting type feeds it (2 = rare summon families, 3 = common units) and the odds: either rates {rarity: weight} or per_unit true + rarities [..] (every unit of the pool has the same odds, a rarity's weight = its unit count). gumi never published the 2014 odds; when it did publish (2018) its legacy pools were flat per unit (Legacy Summon 'evenly distributed', Brave Summon '2% fixed per unit', Super Rare Summon Plus per batch group), so phase 1 uses that rule.
